# Dr. Arun Jayapal

> Independent AI Consultant & Researcher. PhD from Trinity College Dublin. I automate complex processes with agentic AI and build production AI systems for global clients.

Dr. Arun Jayapal is an independent AI consultant with 10+ years of industry experience spanning academic research and enterprise delivery. He holds a PhD in Computational Linguistics from Trinity College Dublin (thesis: *Finding Diachronic Sense Changes by Unsupervised Methods*) and previously led AI delivery at EY, architecting solutions for international clients. He serves as a peer reviewer for CoLing and EACL conferences and has 8+ published research papers in AI/ML venues.

## Services

- [I Automate Processes](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#services): Design of agentic pipelines, LLM workflows, multi-agent architectures, and text analytics systems that eliminate manual bottlenecks.
- [I Build AI Products](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#services): End-to-end architecture and delivery of custom AI systems — from early MVP to enterprise-scale production platforms.

## Expertise

Agentic AI Systems, Multi-Agent Architectures, LLM Integration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Fine-Tuning, Intelligent Document Processing, Sentiment Analysis, Text Mining, Natural Language Processing, Computational Linguistics, AI Strategy & Governance, Production AI Pipeline Architecture.

## Technology Stack

Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGPT, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Celery, Airflow, Docker.

## Selected Work

- [Agentic Ideation Sandbox](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#case-studies): Full-stack collaborative platform where teams assemble AI personas and run multi-agent strategic simulations in real time. Stack: FastAPI, React, Celery, Redis, Gemini.
- [DataFlow — Conversational Data Science Agent](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#case-studies): Agentic assistant that interprets natural language, plans multi-step transformations, and executes statistical analyses on structured data. Stack: FastAPI, React, Gemini, PostgreSQL.
- [Agentic PDF Translation Service](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#case-studies): Agentic pipeline for document translation with cross-page context management, back-translation quality verification, and automatic retry. Stack: FastAPI, Gemini, Sentence Transformers.
- [Agentic Video Localisation Pipeline](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#case-studies): Multi-stage pipeline that fetches captions, orchestrates translation, triggers voice-cloned speech synthesis, and hands off to a video generation agent. Stack: Flask, Gemini, F5-TTS, Dia-1.6B.
- [Video Intelligence API](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#case-studies): FastAPI service processing videos through Gemini Vision to extract insights and generate structured reports. Stack: FastAPI, Gemini Vision, Docker.
- [Event Ticketing & Live Check-in System](https://arunjeyapal.github.io/#case-studies): Production event management platform with QR ticket generation, encrypted PII, and camera-based live check-in. Stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy.
